item.description:
Memophant 3.1.0

Better search, a much more complete code index, and safer memory editing by agents. (There is no 3.0 of the app — the number moves up because the memory engine underneath changed how several things behave.)

Improved

  • Search finds what you mean. File names like ProcessRunner.swift find the notes that mention them, nonsense queries return nothing, AND / OR / NOT are taken literally, and scores are 0–1 everywhere.
  • Code search finds much more. Declarations with attributes like @State or @Test are now indexed, partial names match, and results rank more sensibly. The code index rebuilds once, and reindexing is much faster.
  • Safer note editing by agents. Agents can only edit, move or retire a note they name exactly; a partial or ambiguous name is refused rather than guessed.
  • Links stay pointed where you put them. Moves and renames only update links to the moved note, cleanup no longer re-points links to a merely similar title, and ambiguous links are flagged in Memory Health. Accented titles resolve correctly.

Fixed

  • Searching tasks could crash the app when a task's text contained "İ".
  • Memories, Wiki and Design lists could show the previous query's results, or flash "No matches" mid-search.
  • Search errors are shown instead of a misleading "No matches".
  • Searches with punctuation, like tasks, or (urgent), could fail.
  • An unregistered repository was treated as the "memophant" project; agent tools now refuse until the repo is added.
  • A misspelled project name or wrongly typed argument from an agent is refused instead of ignored.
  • Agent tools stopped responding after a mid-session license unlock.
  • Agent file writes refuse odd paths, and vendor names can't reach outside the vendors folder.
  • Cleaner anonymous analytics: each event counted once, development builds send nothing, opting out always wins (swift-stats 0.3.0).
